author: Komorebi P.
edition_title: Quantum Seeds and Effective Dynamics: Symmetry, geometric transport, quantum channels, and bounded refinement towers
source_branches: Complete corrected v0.6.0 finite release, integrated editorial v0.5.1, all six mathematical completion supplements, original numerical companion, and full strengthened Annals development.

written_preservation.scope: Proof-environment counts overlap conceptually. They do not count distinct discoveries; complete prose derivations in all six supplements are retained in addition to explicit proof environments.

formal_scope.qualification: Each item has its own exact hypotheses. Projected geometry includes real parameter-manifold and bounded-operator constructions beyond a single finite-dimensional chart; physical continuum existence is not concluded.

other_papers.scope: Other papers are unchanged by this task. Earlier series-wide status snapshots are retained as historical records.

limitations: Numerical, rational-example, static-inventory, written-proof and inherited kernel evidence remain separately scoped. No interacting continuum field theory, unbounded gravitational constraint closure, Lorentzian reconstruction, Einstein infrared action or physical massless spin-two sector is claimed.
source_edition_title: Quantum Seed and Packet Calculus: Symmetry, Circuits, Geometric Transport, Channels, Effective Dynamics, and Continuum Towers
series_scope: Paper VII only. Complete prose revision, conservative clarification of existing hypotheses, and pagination repairs. All mathematical source branches and supplements retained. No fresh Lean compilation.

monograph_preservation.interpretation: Every complete part equals the preserved preceding edition plus closed reviewed prose and layout edits. All mathematical spans, labels, citations, environment order and statement/proof inventories independently match the actual retrieved source. Overlapping records do not count independent discoveries.

visual_scope.source_changes: All worked-page prose and routes reviewed. Explanations use complete connected sentences, unnecessary semicolons and editorial hyphens are removed, and evidence dates are explicit. Existing technical notation and drawing geometry are preserved.

fresh_checks.scope: Complete prose/source review, independent focused review, closed preservation checks and their deliberate failure controls, guide static reconciliation, twelve extended plate source regeneration, fresh PDF compilation, rendered page review, actual navigation and archive checks.

unavailable_fresh_gates: Lean compilation and compiler rejection controls; Lean, Lake and Elan are absent, and the portable compiler kit is not included in the retrieved package.
open_continuum_targets: Uniform Feshbach control for the proposed tower
raw_source_policy: All 784 retrieved source files, both recovery ZIPs and thirteen comparison-baseline files match the actual October 11 delivery, including 121 inherited Lean files. The preceding October 18 prose, PDFs and metadata are preserved under provenance/pre_final_prose_2026-10-18. Older font-removal changes are not attributed to this task.
font_policy: No standalone font binaries were added. Builders use bundled font files if present; otherwise they explicitly select installed OpenType P052 and Nimbus Sans faces, Latin Modern and the documented code fonts. Font licenses from the retrieved package remain.
